title: Classic Apple Pie
description: A double-crust apple pie with tender, cinnamon-spiced apples in a thick filling that holds together when you slice it.
scaleNote: One batch makes one {len 9 in} pie. Bake a second pie for 16 slices.

image.alt: A lattice-topped apple pie with a slice cut

ingredients.prep: peeled, cored and sliced {len 1/4 in} thick
ingredients.note: about {count 7} medium; mix tart and sweet

steps.text: Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} with a rack in the lower third and a baking sheet on it. Line the pie plate with one crust.
Toss the apples with the sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, nutmeg, salt and lemon juice. Pile them into the crust, mounding them in the center, and dot with the butter.
Lay the second crust over the top, trim, fold the edges under and crimp to seal. Cut {count 5} slits in the top. Brush with the egg and sprinkle with sugar.

Bake on the hot baking sheet for {time 20 min}. Lower the heat to {temp 375F oven} and bake until the crust is deep golden and the filling bubbles thickly through the slits, {time 40-50 min}. Cover the edges with foil if they brown too fast.
Cool the pie completely, at least {time 4 hr notimer}, before slicing, or the filling will run.

notes: Some store-bought pie crusts are made with lard; check the label, or use an all-butter crust.
The pie keeps 2 days at room temperature, loosely covered.
